_comment: Owner policy for publishing iptv-org discovered streams in TVKu. A stream is only ever published after it passes Tier B playback validation; this file decides which candidates may be validated at all. Domain evidence is not a licence: broadcasters can ask for removal at any time (see docs/CHANNEL_CANDIDATES_D3.md, takedown).
_approved_brand_domain_comment: brand_domain = the stream host contains the channel's brand but is not the listed website. Approved only per channel after owner review.
_excluded_comment: Conservative default: channels owned or operated by broadcasters under US/EU sanctions, or broadcasting from sanctioned territories, are not distributed by TVKu. The owner can change this list.
_distribution_feed_comment: Feeds made for a specific distribution partner (FAST platforms) are not the broadcaster's public stream.
